title: Test Cloudflare secondary CDN failover in staging
description:
Before Feb 15 CloudInfra maintenance, need to verify Cloudflare secondary CDN works as failover. Test in staging environment:

1. Configure DNS to point to Cloudflare
2. Verify cache behavior and hit ratio
3. Test with simulated CloudInfra failure
4. Document switching procedure in runbook
5. Measure failover time (DNS propagation)

This is critical for rollback plan if CloudInfra error rate exceeds 10%.

Related: OBSN-9 runbook, OBSN-10 learning notes

title: Draft customer notification for CloudInfra CDN maintenance
description:
CTO requested customer notification draft for Premium tier clients about Feb 15-16 CDN maintenance.

Recipients: CUS-101 (数据云科技), CUS-102 (智汇网络), CUS-103 (创新软件)

Key points to include:
- Maintenance window: Feb 15 10:00 - Feb 16 14:00 Beijing Time
- Expected impact: Intermittent errors (2-5%), possible latency increase
- Services affected: Web application, media streaming
- Our preparation: Increased timeouts, monitoring, rollback plan ready
- Emphasize proactive measures and monitoring

Keep brief and professional. Send draft to CTO for review by Feb 10 morning.

Related: OBSN-9 runbook, Fossify Notes impact assessment

title: Run health check regression suite before CDN maintenance
description:
T-2h before CloudInfra CDN maintenance (Feb 15 08:00), run full health check regression suite to establish baseline.

Scheduler job: JOB-702

Verify:
- All services passing health checks
- No existing issues that could confuse maintenance monitoring
- Origin server capacity headroom >40%

Document baseline metrics for comparison during maintenance window.

Related: OBSN-9 runbook section 'T-2h Pre-Maintenance'
